corrections.why: firelookout.com gives a 40-foot pole tower for Mount High (about 12.2 m). The record's 50-foot (15.2 m) figure matches only the 1937 newspaper's description of towers planned for the forest.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com gives a 40-foot pole tower; the October 1937 Big Timber Pioneer item describes the forest's planned 50-foot towers, not this tower's height. The story uses the site-specific 40-foot figure and explains the 50-foot item.
firelookout.com says destroyed in 1968; the 1972 NGS station description says the tower was removed and gives no cause. The story reports both without choosing one.

notes_for_editor: The brief's 15.2 m height is the 1937 planned tower height (50 ft); firelookout.com gives 40 ft for this site, so the record is corrected to 12.2 m. The record's gone status and coordinates match the sources. Fate is unsettled between destroyed (1968) and removed (by 1972). The NGS description was reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page; no primary NGS datasheet was fetched. No source describes the site today or whether it is open, so the access key is omitted. Not verified on the ground.
